title: Geographic Destination Labeling Error
claimed_statement: Reported 14.0441 S, 15.4063 W labeled as 'Indian Ocean' in Phase 6 summaries
physical_reality: 15.4063 W at 14.0441 S is in the South Atlantic Ocean (midway between Brazil and Namibia)
action_taken: Correcting geographic destination labels across config and docs

title: Mass Ledger Documentation Conflation
claimed_statement: Reported 220.85 t insertion, 4.577 t payload removal, 177.27 t entry mass appeared to have 39 t discrepancy
physical_reality: Payload removal was 39.0 t (26 Starlinks x 1500 kg); 4577.29 kg was deorbit burn propellant. Exact balance: 220850 - 39000 - 4577.29 = 177272.71 kg
action_taken: Authored mass balance ledger and automated test test_mass_balance.py

title: 100k CAD Parts vs Relational BOM
claimed_statement: High-level summaries claimed '100,000+ component CAD model'
physical_reality: FreeCAD contains 12 core parametric B-Rep solids; 100065 items exist as SQLite relational metadata records (29.3 MB DB) to prevent 8 GB RAM OOM crashes
action_taken: Enforcing strict terminology: 12 B-Rep solids vs 100k relational BOM items

title: Center-of-Mass Range vs Physical Surface Clearance
claimed_statement: Reported 5.50 m (1s) and 48.06 m (5s) clearance without specifying reference points
physical_reality: These values are Center-of-Mass relative displacements in a 3-DOF point-mass model; physical surface clearance requires stage geometry
action_taken: Renamed to center_displacement_m and documented geometric bounding box limits

title: Negative Perigee Terminology
claimed_statement: Osculating perigee of -81.09 km described as an 'orbit'
physical_reality: Negative perigee altitude represents an Earth-intersecting suborbital disposal trajectory which terminates at entry interface
action_taken: Labeled as EARTH_INTERSECTING_DISPOSAL_TRAJECTORY terminating at 120 km interface

title: Sea-Level Trajectory Endpoint vs Soft Landing
claimed_statement: Endpoint at sea level (h=0m) could be misconstrued as recovery
physical_reality: Vehicle impacts sea level at aerodynamic terminal velocity (209.7 m/s / Mach 0.62) without flip or landing burn; it is a high-speed water impact
action_taken: Explicitly classified as HIGH_SPEED_WATER_IMPACT with zero recovery claim

title: Dual-Interpreter Toolchain Fragmentation
claimed_statement: System Python 3.14 lacks SciPy and Matplotlib while FreeCAD Python 3.11 possesses them
physical_reality: Tests and scripts must clearly document which interpreter is required for which task
action_taken: Documented in ENVIRONMENT_MATRIX.md and created unified execution runners
